title: Universal halting has polynomial circuit size
statement: For every machine representation scheme $c$, the unary language of numbers whose binary expansions begin with $1s$, where $s$ encodes an advice string and an input on which the machine decoded from that advice halts, has Boolean circuits of fan-in at most two and size bounded by a polynomial in the input length.
